title: Scenario 7: Internal Network Reconnaissance
description: Before moving laterally, APT29 performs network reconnaissance to map the environment. This includes port scanning and service enumeration.
hunt_for: Rapid sequential connection attempts to multiple hosts or ports from a single source. Look for connections to common admin ports (22, 445, 3389, 5985).
kibana_query: EventID:3 AND (DestinationPort:22 OR DestinationPort:445 OR DestinationPort:3389 OR DestinationPort:5985)
detection_tips: Group network connections by source IP
Look for connections to many destination IPs in short timeframe
Identify scanning of common administrative ports
Check for failed connection attempts (indicators of scanning)
key_indicators: High ratio of failed to successful connections
